entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Mike Johnson. Order number is VF98765.
Thank you, Mike. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the Velo-Tech Performance Jersey, delivered on January 5th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
I understand. Is it a technical fault with the item, or is it a preference issue with the fit?
It's just too tight. Your size chart online is clearly useless.

I'm sorry to hear the fit wasn't what you expected. I can definitely process a return for you. Our apparel, including this jersey, has a 90-day return window, so you're well within that timeframe. We can set up a full refund or an exchange for a larger size. Which would you prefer?
Fine. I guess I'll try an exchange.

Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for one size up. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Please use that label to send back the original item, and as soon as it's scanned by the carrier, we will ship out the replacement.
Whatever. Just make sure it actually ships.
Absolutely. You'll receive a tracking number as soon as the new one is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mike?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
